description: This file defines the LoanSecurityUnpledge class for handling loan security unpledge operations, including validation, approval, and status updates within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanSecurityUnpledge
classes.description: Class managing the unpledge process for loan securities, including validation, approval, and status updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the unpledge document, checking for duplicate securities and unpledge quantities.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when the unpledge is canceled, updating the loan status accordingly.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_securities
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate securities are added in the unpledge document.

methods.name: validate_unpledge_qty
methods.description: Validates that the unpledge quantities do not exceed pledged amounts and maintains LTV ratios.

methods.name: _throw
methods.description: Raises an exception with a message if LTV ratio constraints are breached.

methods.name: on_update_after_submit
methods.description: Triggers approval process after the document is submitted.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves the unpledge if conditions are met, updating the loan status.

methods.name: update_loan_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the associated loan based on pledge quantities and cancellation.
